english.title: Attempt buggery with a boy under 16 years of age
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to committed buggery with **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), a boy under the age of 16 years, namely of the age of **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..)
english.pointstoprove:
Date and location
attempt to committed buggery
with a boy under the age of 16 years

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence became OBSOLETE from 03/11/1994.

The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for buggery of a boy under sixteen years of age.
MOPI RETENTION: Review of offence record and retain in line with its modern equivalent. If the offender was under 18, MOPI 2 offences may apply.

other.penalty:
Indictable: Life imprisonment

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
